content: Sylric was an English soldier that joined when he was far too young in hopes for an adventure. He is friendly and loves making friends while playing cards and was really good at it. He left the military as they kept him inside managing supplies and nothing more. Killing time at a desk more often then being outside. Sylric heavily practiced in both his work time and free time, with the mindset that he will have to be ready for any real wars that might come, but it felt that something like that would never come. It was bitter sweet to him, he's glad that people are safe and no one was fighting each other, but it was never for the purpose of making his country proud or to even go out to war, but so he could find something interesting or something different from his homeland or even his hometown for that matter. It was not until some of his good friends both outside the military and inside that he told about a promise for a better adventure and more opportunities in the well known town and only a little ways from where he was, London.  With that in mind and a strong passion to leave the unwanted military and to find a better adventure. He left the military and excitement of change, Sylric headed for London!

Lt Pandy gathers as many of you together as possible and reveals some disturbing news to you.
"It's worse than I thought. I apologize for distancing myself from you, but given current difficulties, it has been unavoidable. Besides our little incident, you have conducted yourselves magnificently. I am confident that you will prevail in this farce of a trial. As unpleasant as that is, I must first explain a bit more, and then ask more of you. 

"First, we are at war. The other factions have put plans into motions that must be stopped. Those fools think they know what they are doing, but it is folly. They are playing with powers too large for them, and they will destroy the world if they are not careful. For now let me just say that they are uncovering items of power. Some of these are inconsequential to our goals, but others...others are very necessary. 

"The Knights du roi soleil have been acquiring artifacts. If you find any of these, bring them to me. But not until we arrive at our destination. Keep them save until then. I know they have some in their possession even now. We will get those eventually. But tonight they have unwittingly stumbled up on one. Should any of them return alive, I need you to acquire a bag of holding for me. It is...special. I will reimburse you up to 500 gold if you can get it for me. Try not to let anyone know that you are collecting these. We have many to gather, and very little time to do it. This is the first, but there will be more. We are entering powerful and ancient waters. More will be revealed at the appropriate time."
